context.description: Plan context: key_files, patterns, constraints (constraints[0] is the verbatim user description), and optional project_docs (doc paths consulted during research, forwarded to reviewers).

constraints.description: Pitfalls and design rationale. constraints[0] is the verbatim user description.

project_docs.description: Doc paths consulted during research, forwarded to reviewers.

milestones.description: Array of direct implementation milestones. Each milestone has id, goal, files, tasks, and verification. Never include discovery or decision milestones.

files.description: Repo-relative paths the milestone is expected to touch.

tasks.description: The concrete changes of the milestone.

test_scenarios.description: Plain statements of the expected behavior.

verification.description: A runnable command that proves this milestone alone.

qualitative_verification.description: The judgment that no command can prove, or null.

success_criteria.description: Measurable criteria for the implementation to be considered complete.

implementation_contract.description: A compact contract for the implementer: 1-4 directives, each { id, text, completion_check }. fly.spec-create originates it and spec-review preserves an existing contract. Downstream work agents echo every directive in contract_result.

directives.description: One concrete commitment for each directive.

text.description: The commitment the diff either satisfies or does not.

completion_check.description: A file, test, command, or exact symbol the work handoff can cite.
